record.description_evidence:
Make AI actually work for you — at work, every day.

sqills turns "I should really learn AI" into a habit you'll keep. Instead of watching endless tutorials, you work through short, hands-on lessons — real tasks you finish inside the app — and walk away with skills you can use the same day.

WHY sqills
Most people don't lack access to AI tools. They lack a clear path: what to do with them, why it works, and how to make it stick. sqills gives you that path, built around your role and your goals.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick the AI tools you want to learn and tell us about your work
- Follow a path of guided missions, each broken into short lessons
- Browse a library of real-world use cases across work and life
- Stay current with the in-app AI news feed

USE CASES FOR WORK AND LIFE
Short, practical guides that help you get something done with AI — across personal, lifestyle, finance, product, research, and marketing. Find one for your task, follow it, keep the result.

TOOLS YOU'LL LEARN
Get hands-on with today's most useful AI tools — including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

WHAT YOU'LL PRACTICE
- Writing prompts that get useful results the first time
- Using AI to research, summarize, and decide faster
- Drafting emails, content, and documents in your voice
- Turning one idea into content across formats
- Automating repetitive work so you stop doing it by hand

BUILT FOR PROFESSIONALS
Marketers, consultants, managers, freelancers, founders, teachers — anyone who wants to stop feeling behind. No coding. No jargon. Beginner or already experimenting, sqills meets you where you are.

FREE TRIAL & SUBSCRIPTION ACCESS
App is free to download. Access to the app’s learning experience requires starting a free trial or purchasing a subscription. After the free trial ends, your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or current billing period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

AI & PRIVACY
sqills uses Google's Gemini API to power in-app practice — it reviews the prompts you write and gives you feedback. You'll see exactly what's shared before you use these features.

sqills is an independent learning app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, or any other tool provider. All product names and logos are trademarks of their respective owners.

Privacy Policy: https://sqills.ai/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://sqills.ai/terms-of-use.html

your objectives and risk tolerance, while Allie, our AI-powered assistant, provides educational insights to

support your decisions. All investing involves risk, including the possible loss of principal.

stated goals and risk profile.

record.name: MausBot: Private AI Agents
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Hand real work to AI agents that run on your own computer, and carry them in your pocket. MausBot is the iPhone app for OpenMausBot, the open-source agent runtime you install on your own Mac, Windows or Linux machine.

Your bots work on your hardware, with your keys, on your files. Nothing is uploaded to us.

WORK YOU CAN HAND OFF
· Inbox triage: read the morning's mail, flag what matters, draft replies, send nothing without your yes
· Pull request review: read a diff, leave comments, open the follow-up issue
· Bug reproduction: drive a browser until the bug happens, then write it up with the steps
· Standup digest: gather what moved yesterday and post the summary to Slack
· Issue grooming: tidy a Linear backlog, label it, close what already shipped
· Research watch: check a list of sites overnight and report what changed
· Portal errands: log into the dull vendor site, download the invoices, park them for review
· Codebase chores: run the migration, fix the lint, open the branch

MESSAGE A BOT LIKE A TEAMMATE
Send work from your phone the way you would text a colleague. Pick up the same thread on your computer. Each bot keeps its own model, its own computer and its own instructions, and comes back to you only when it needs a decision.

A BOT ASKS BEFORE IT ACTS
Shell commands, file edits and open questions arrive as cards you answer with one tap, from the lock screen if you like. Nothing risky happens while you are away without your approval. The gate is the point.

TALK TO IT OUT LOUD
Start a Live call and brief a bot by voice while you walk, with the chat open beside you.

MANY BOTS, IN PARALLEL
Run a bot per job. One owns a project, one watches the inbox, one keeps the build green. Put several in a channel and they pass work between themselves. A cross-bot inbox shows everything waiting on you in one place.

IT KEEPS GOING WITHOUT YOU
Routines run work on a schedule, from every few minutes to selected weekdays. Webhooks let another system start a job. Your computer does the work whether or not your phone is awake.

CONNECTED APPS
OAuth once and every bot can use Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear and hundreds more as tools.

BRING YOUR OWN BRAIN
Bots run on the Claude, Codex and Grok CLIs already installed on your machine. Switch a bot's model mid-conversation.

PRIVATE BY ARCHITECTURE
MausBot talks straight to the companion service on your own computer. Transcripts and keys stay in local storage on that machine. Pair with a short-lived code from Remote access, and revoke the phone whenever you want.

AT HOME OR AWAY
On a trusted network the phone finds your computer by itself. For remote access, install Tailscale on both and connect by MagicDNS name.

Requires OpenMausBot on a Mac, Windows or Linux computer. Free and open source. Tailscale is optional and is not affiliated with OpenMausBot.

record.description_evidence:
PocketClaw puts the AI agent running on your own computer in your pocket. Built for self-hosted, open-source agent runtimes — with first-class support for OpenClaw and Hermes — it lets you continue conversations, monitor long-running work, and stay in control from iPhone or iPad.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Continue the same agent conversations and context away from your computer
• Connect your self-hosted OpenClaw and Hermes agents in one app
• Follow the latest completed response with Live Activities and Dynamic Island
• Run commands, tools, scheduled tasks, and automations remotely
• Review tool output and exchange supported files and images
• Manage sessions, models, skills, projects, and multiple gateways
• Diagnose Relay and Agent Runtime connectivity separately

HOW IT WORKS

Install ClawPilot on the computer that runs your agent, generate a one-time pairing code, and connect it to PocketClaw. Messages and commands transit the configured PocketClaw Relay so they can reach your own agent host. Connection diagnostics distinguish the Relay, Agent Runtime, model provider, and local tool layers when something fails.

POCKETCLAW PRO

Pro unlocks advanced mobile controls, automation, diagnostics, and multi-gateway features. PocketClaw does not impose a daily message cap on eligible Pro messaging features. Model tokens, API quotas, billing, and provider rate limits are controlled by your own agent configuration and model provider and are not included with PocketClaw Pro.

Monthly, annual, and lifetime options may be available. Current localized prices and eligibility are shown on the App Store purchase screen. Payment is charged to your Apple ID after confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

OpenClaw and Hermes are open-source agent runtimes that you install and operate on your own hardware. PocketClaw is an independent, third-party companion app: it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the OpenClaw or Hermes projects, or any model provider mentioned. record.description_evidence:
Most AI tells you what to do. Superchat does it for you.

The call you keep putting off. The bill due Friday. The dinner you still have not booked. A dozen small things, none of them hard, all of them waiting. Superchat handles all of it.

Tell it what you need, in a message or out loud, and it gets on with it. Not a plan. Not a list of steps for you to follow. The actual thing, done.

Ask it to book a table and the table is booked. Ask it to pay a bill and the bill is paid. Ask it to send the email and it is sent. Ask it to write up your meeting and the notes are ready before you leave the room. Ask where your order is and it tells you, down to the stop. Ask it to call the clinic, and it makes the call, speaks for you, and comes back with the time.

This is the difference. Other assistants give you a plan. Superchat gives you the result.

What it handles

Calls, on your behalf. It speaks to the clinic, the restaurant, the office, and tells you what they said.

Bookings of every kind. Tables, flights, hotels, cars, tickets.

Money. Pay bills, send money, track what you spend.

Shopping and groceries. It compares, orders, and follows the delivery.

Your inbox and chats. It reads, replies and follows up so nothing is left hanging.

Reminders and routines. It stays ahead of renewals and deadlines, and runs the tasks you repeat.

Still an assistant, in every other way

When you just want to ask, it answers. Draft a message, plan a trip, settle a question, think something through, get advice before a decision. Everything you would expect from a good assistant, with one difference: when the answer is something that needs doing, it does that too.

One chat for all of it

No tabs. No app switching. No working out where to start.

Say it once. It is handled.

Private by default

Your data stays yours. We never sell your information. Everything is encrypted.

The to-do list was never the point. Your time was.

Superchat. Life, handled.

Smart Pool AI — Pool Control That Actually Works

Works with Pentair IntelliCenter®, Pentair ScreenLogic®, Jandy® iAquaLink®, and Hayward® OmniLogic®. Built for pool owners who want more than the stock app — faster, smarter, and more reliable, on every device you own.

FAST, RELIABLE CONTROL
Turn your pool, spa, lights, jets, waterfall, and more on or off instantly. No spinning wheels, no dropped commands, no hunting through menus.

SMART HEAT — KNOW EXACTLY WHEN IT'S READY
Smart Pool AI learns your pool's real heat-up rate and tells you before you even turn the heater on: "Takes ~26 min to heat to 97°F" — right on the card. Set a target time and it starts the heater automatically, tracks progress live on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, and tells you the moment it's ready.

SMART SCENES — YOUR VIBE
Save your perfect pool setup as a scene. One tap for Movie Night. One tap for Morning Swim. Tell Alexa to set the scene hands-free.

REAL-TIME STATUS
Water temperature, equipment status, and schedules — live, at a glance.

KIOSK MODE — CONTROL FROM THE WALL
Mount an iPad by your pool and flip it landscape. Smart Pool AI transforms into a full-screen control panel — everything at a glance, always on, always ready. Perfect for outdoor kitchens, pool houses, or anywhere you want hands-free control within reach.

DARK MODE
Easy on the eyes day or night. Automatically matches your device setting.

BUILT BY A POOL OWNER
Frustrated by apps that don't work, I built this for myself — and for every pool owner who deserves better, whatever brand runs their equipment.
